about: E-SY's GBC-style Pokémon sprite compilation (one big sheet: a panel per generation, then a panel of forms). Cells are 56x56 at 1x on a 72-pixel grid, white inside a 7-pixel coloured frame (big sprites spill onto it); front and back side by side, six Pokémon to a row, in national order. Panel n's first cell starts at x = 15 + 870n, y = 63. Only what Gen 3 has and the Game Boy games don't is taken: Hoenn (the Gen 3 panel), Castform's weather forms, Deoxys's forms, and Unown ! and ?. Point make_gbc_hoenn.py at the sheet PNG.
